body:
The training pipeline is now real and working. gymnasium/stable_baselines3
confirmed installed (a real change from an earlier session's claim they
weren't available in this sandbox).

New scripts/rl_env_packet.py: real gymnasium.Env speaking SHANKPIT's actual
wire protocol byte-for-byte, direct Python ports of apps2/emily-bot's own
observation.go (84 features) and reward.go (4-tier reward). 26 new
network-free unit tests, all passing. New scripts/rl_train_packet.py: real
PPO training script.

Found and fixed 3 real, previously-unknown, LIVE-production-impacting bugs
while actually running the pipeline (not code review alone):
1. QUEUE connect never spawned the player (health/state/weapon left at 0).
2. phys_respawn's scene whitelist missing SCENE_CUSTOM_LEVEL -- every QUEUE
   death->respawn was silently kicking the player out of NEWPIT back to
   GARAGE_OSAKA. The standing bot pool has hit this on every death since
   S459-41.
3. No void/out-of-bounds death existed anywhere -- a player falling off any
   level's geometry fell forever at full health with no recovery.

Added --fast-forward to the server (mirrors ECOWAR/BRAWLPIT), verified
~500K ticks/sec.

A real PPO training run completed end-to-end after the void-kill fix: 4096
timesteps, 8 real update iterations, checkpoint saved and verified to load
back via PPO.load and produce a real predicted action.

Live server, bot pool, and a fresh Windows client all redeployed.

Commit: SHANKPIT@b25f879. Doc: docs/BOT_TRAINING_NORTHSTAR.md §9.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-48: real packet-level PPO training pipeline working end-to-end, 3 live-production bugs found+fixed
